house.description: Penalty for tampering with a motor vehicle increased, and crime for riding in a vehicle when the person reasonably should have known that a vehicle was taken without permission established.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; increasing the penalty for tampering with a motor vehicle; establishing a crime for riding in a vehicle when the person reasonably should have known that a vehicle was taken without permission; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.546.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 609.546, is amended to read:

609.546 MOTOR VEHICLE TAMPERING.
A person is guilty of a [+gross +]misdemeanor who intentionally:
(1) rides in or on a motor vehicle [-knowing-][+ when the person knows or reasonably should know+] that the vehicle was taken and is being driven by another without the owner's permission; or
(2) tampers with or enters into or on a motor vehicle without the owner's permission.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective August 1, 2025, and applies to crimes committed on or after that date. +]
